title: Argos expands marketplace beauty offering with K-beauty favourite Medicube and Dermalogica
summary: The UK retailer’s Trusted Seller platform will grow from 70,000 products from third-party sellers to 130,000 by the end of the year, including health and beauty brands Clarins, Dermalogica and Medicube

extraction.key_fact: 영국 유통업체 아르고스가 메디큐브와 더말로지카 등을 포함해 마켓플레이스 뷰티 제품군을 대폭 확대한다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Argos expands marketplace beauty offering with K-beauty favourite Medicube and Dermalogica
